purpose: Freeze the public baselines for the P8 (MATCHED_RENDERER) / P9 (SYSTEM_LEVEL_CONTEXT) / P10 (composition prep) campaign stages. No performance runs are launched by this freeze; P7 residual-attribution closure must complete first (see launch_gate).

launch_gate.blocked_by: P7 residual attribution closure (other DSH, in progress)
launch_gate.rule: No official timing run, no GPU occupation, until P7 is confirmed complete and GPUs verified clean via the clean-GPU snapshot convention (two scans >=120s apart, zero processes, <500 MiB).
launch_gate.clean_gpu_policy: scripts/publication/publication_scheduler.py convention: dynamic clean-GPU selection, sticky contamination flags, per-run nvidia-smi snapshot (harness/final30k/capture_provenance.py).
launch_gate.cohort_policy: Never mix hardware cohorts (mx A100-PCIE-40GB vs EPIC-05 A100-SXM4-80GB). P8/P9 wall comparisons must stay within one cohort and one torch/CUDA env per arm family (docs/hardware.md, SKILL.md section 24).

verification_method: Upstream HEADs verified 2026-09-25 via `git ls-remote <url> HEAD`; local shallow clones under public_baselines/ (CPU/disk only, no GPU).

label_taxonomy.MATCHED_RENDERER: All P8 controls literally satisfied (same scene split, 30K iterations, resolution, loss, camera sequence, optimizer, densification protocol, seed, eval metrics; eps2d recorded and matched to the maximum technically possible).
label_taxonomy.MATCHED_RENDERER_WITH_DISCLOSURE: Runs under the unified matched trainer but carries >=1 disclosed, irreducible deviation (e.g. the method's own densification statistic, or a non-parameterizable rasterizer filter form). Renderer-level comparisons are permitted ONLY with the deviation disclosure attached. NOT a strict MATCHED_RENDERER label.
label_taxonomy.SYSTEM_LEVEL_CONTEXT: The method's own training system is preserved end-to-end. No renderer-level winner claims may be derived from rows with this label.

graphdeco_original_3dgs.integration_notes: P1 wrapper fixes (make_publication_trainer.py P1-P20): opacities unsqueeze [N,1], radii reshape [1,N,1], means2D kwarg spelling, 3-tuple return; verified by 200-iter smoke then P1 gates

gsplat_main.optimizer: Adam (or SparseAdam/SelectiveAdam), lr * sqrt(batch_size*world_size), eps=1e-15/sqrt(BS), betas scaled by BS, fused=True; means lr additionally x scene_scale, ExponentialLR gamma=0.01^(1/max_steps); lrs: means 1.6e-4, scales 5e-3, opacities 5e-2, quats 1e-3, sh0 2.5e-3, shN 2.5e-3/20
gsplat_main.evaluation_protocol: eval at [7000, 30000]; torchmetrics PeakSignalNoiseRatio + StructuralSimilarityIndexMeasure (data_range 1.0) + LPIPS (alex normalize=True default; vgg normalize=False option); test views = every test_every(8)-th index; rendered at training resolution factor
gsplat_main.seed_camera_sequence: set_random_seed(42 + local_rank); train DataLoader shuffle=True (NO fixed camera sequence upstream). P8 imposes the frozen camera sequence via the unified matched trainer (same mechanism as b0/b1/b1a arms)
gsplat_main.integration_notes: v1.6.0 restructured vs v1.5.3 (gsplat/strategy/ package; torch.library.register_autograd backend). P8 requires a publication_trainer arm wrapping rasterization() with eps2d=0.1, absgrad=True, tile_size=16, packed=False, rasterize_mode='classic'; 200-iter integration smoke required before any gate run.

taming_3dgs_rasterizer_only_exact.training_recipe: stock Inria recipe on this branch (iterations 30000, densify 500-15000 interval 100, signed-grad 2e-4, opacity reset 3000); the branch README states densification-scheme changes are NOT included
taming_3dgs_rasterizer_only_exact.resolution_behavior: identical to original 3DGS (-r default -1 auto-1600px; images_2/images_4 conventions)
taming_3dgs_rasterizer_only_exact.loss_definition: identical to original 3DGS (0.8*L1 + 0.2*(1-SSIM)); adds fused_ssim CUDA kernels (conv.cu, hardcoded 11x11) used as fast_ssim

eps2d_antialiasing.form: hardcoded covariance-diagonal low-pass cov += 0.3f (identical to original graphdeco; NOT parameterizable)

taming_3dgs_rasterizer_only_exact.optimizer: stock torch.optim.Adam (lr=0, eps=1e-15) with Inria per-group lrs; OPTIONAL SparseGaussianAdam (--optimizer_type sparse_adam). Sparse Adam is NOT numerically equivalent to dense Adam: invisible Gaussians skip exp_avg/exp_avg_sq decay and no bias correction is applied (README: 'this can change the training behaviour'). P8 matched arm MUST use the dense default optimizer.

rasterizer_modifications_vs_original.exact_tile_culling: max_contrib_power_rect_gaussian: a Gaussian/tile pair is dropped only when its max possible contribution <= 1/255, which the render loop skips anyway -> output-invariant (exact)
rasterizer_modifications_vs_original.backward_parallelization: sampled-state checkpointing (every 32nd splat) + warp-parallel per-Gaussian replay backward; recomputation, NOT a moment/bbox approximation; buckets past per-tile max_contrib are skipped, which is exact because last_contributor <= max_contrib
rasterizer_modifications_vs_original.separate_dc_sh: degree-0 SH split from higher SHs (pipe.separate_sh=True); API adapter required
rasterizer_modifications_vs_original.quat_normalization_removed: glm::length(rot) division removed in forward and the dnormvdv correction commented out in backward (paper claims numerical equivalence; MUST be verified by the P8 gradient-equivalence gate, not assumed)
rasterizer_modifications_vs_original.fused_adam_kernel: _C.adamUpdate CUDA Adam step (used only by sparse_adam path)
rasterizer_modifications_vs_original.no_mode_switches: no env vars / #ifdef selectable approximate paths in the rasterizer (verified by grep); only include guards

taming_3dgs_rasterizer_only_exact.exactness_claim: README: 'performance optimizations as drop-in replacements'; 'all other changes don't affect the numerical results' (sparse adam excepted). Classification as EXACT is conditional on the P8 pre-gate (forward/gradient equivalence) passing.
disclosed_deviations: 2D filter form: hardcoded cov-diagonal +0.3, not a parameterizable eps2d (same class as b0)
Quaternion normalization removed in forward/backward (claimed equivalent; gate-verified before any P8 run is labeled)
API deviations: separate dc/sh tensors, extra outputs (num_rendered, bucket_sum), forward stores pixel_colors/sample-state buffers
taming_3dgs_rasterizer_only_exact.integration_notes: Wrapper differences vs b0: separate dc/sh channel plumbing, 3-tuple-style returns with bucket_sum, scores/sample-state args absent on this branch's render call (scores plumbing belongs to speedy/fastgs lineage, not here). Requires a publication_trainer arm + build under cu128 (unverified) + 200-iter smoke + gradient-equivalence gate.

cross_baseline_notes.eps2d_forms: Two irreducible filter parameterizations exist: gsplat-family (eps2d added to covariance eigenvalues; parameterizable: B1A 0.1, C0/A0 0.3, gsplat_main library default 0.3) and graphdeco-family (hardcoded cov-diagonal += 0.3: b0, taming_rasterizer, fastgs, speedy_splat). Any cross-family table must state the form and value per arm; P4 (eps2d MATERIAL_CONFOUND on quality axis) applies to the 0.1-vs-0.3 axis within the gsplat family.
cross_baseline_notes.garden_data_caveat: The P5/c42 external cohorts used a manually-created COLMAP garden variant; P9 must NOT reuse it. The adapters point every P9 system at the canonical 13-scene dataset layout, so the garden-collapse caveat is retired going forward (P5 numbers keep their caveat permanently).
cross_baseline_notes.lpips_variant: graphdeco-family metrics.py uses LPIPS-VGG; gsplat-family uses torchmetrics LPIPS (alex default). P8 eval-side uses the frozen matched-protocol metrics (PSNR + SepSSIM + LPIPS per final30k trainer); P9 reports each system's native metrics with the variant recorded.
cross_baseline_notes.binary_identity: Every P8/P9 arm must record its built-extension SHA-256 in provenance at build time (convention: b1a_accutile_build_identity.json / @_build_candidate_c_audit.py). Validation rejects any run whose binary or source commit differs from the frozen expectation.
